# Qiao Partners

> Qiao Partners helps Chinese manufacturers enter and sell across Europe: market entry and compliance, distribution, client management and negotiation, handled locally by one partner.

Qiao Partners is an independent China–Europe market entry and strategic business development firm based in Warsaw, Poland. It helps Chinese manufacturers enter Europe and builds, runs and grows their European distribution: market entry and compliance, distribution and channel management, client and account management, and negotiation of commercial agreements. It also supports selected European companies entering China. It is not a law firm, tax adviser, certification body or investment adviser, and it does not invest or give investment advice.

## Services
- [Market Entry & Compliance](https://qiaopartners.eu/services/#market-entry): We assess demand, prices and competitors for your products, choose the entry and distribution model, and coordinate everything needed to sell legally in Europe: certification, importer of record, entity, customs and tax, with qualified specialists.
- [Distribution & Channel Management](https://qiaopartners.eu/services/#distribution): We select, appoint and manage distributors, dealers and system integrators across Europe, or act as your appointed distribution partner for agreed countries. We set channel structure, pricing and terms, and coordinate logistics, stock and after-sales with qualified partners.
- [Client & Account Management](https://qiaopartners.eu/services/#client-management): We identify and win buyers, manage key accounts locally and in their language, follow orders, claims and service requests, and keep headquarters informed with regular pipeline and market reporting.
- [Negotiation & Commercial Agreements](https://qiaopartners.eu/services/#negotiation): We lead or support negotiations with distributors, buyers and tender authorities: price, exclusivity, payment terms, warranty and liability. Agreements are drafted and reviewed with qualified lawyers.

## Industries
- Industrial Technology & Advanced Manufacturing: Industrial automation, Robotics, Machinery, Industrial components, Advanced materials, Manufacturing technologies
- Energy & Infrastructure: Battery energy storage systems, Battery technologies, Solar, Power electronics, Transformers and grid infrastructure, Renewable energy equipment, Biomethane technologies, Industrial energy systems
- Mobility & Automotive: Automotive components, EV supply chains, Commercial vehicles, Charging infrastructure, Battery components, Mobility technologies
- Digital & Critical Infrastructure: AI data-centre infrastructure, Data-centre cooling, Power distribution, Industrial digitalisation, Selected technology infrastructure
- Aluminium Products: Aluminium extrusions and profiles, Sheet, coil and foil, Windows, doors and façade systems, Automotive and battery-enclosure components, Heat sinks and electronics housings, Aluminium household and consumer goods
